page_title: AUG 2-1 PAU | Augsburg v St. Pauli 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Nikola Vasilj pulls off an easy save.
90+4' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Augsburg have a free kick.
90+1' Today's referee Sascha Stegemann rightly decides to book James Sands (St. Pauli) for his harsh tackle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' St. Pauli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Gregoritsch trots off the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
84' Substitution. Manolis Saliakas will be replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
81' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Finn Dahmen, who pulls off a stunning save!
77' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) replaces Marius Wolf.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch for Elvis Rexhbecaj.
76' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
76' The attendance for today's match is 30660.
73' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

73' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, St. Pauli are going to take it.
71' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Joel Fujita and he is replaced by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
69' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Sascha Stegemann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
66' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:3.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is replacing Ricky-Jade Jones.
63' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. Danel Sinani is replaced by Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli).
62' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabian Rieder leaves the pitch and Anton Kade (Augsburg) comes on.

59' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
57' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' The corner from Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
52' Close! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
50' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
49' A long pass, executed by Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
47' James Sands (St. Pauli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' Manuel Baum has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Yannik Keitel (Augsburg) comes on the pitch for Arthur Chaves.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg). Sascha Stegemann doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

41' 1 - 1 Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
41' The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
39' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
37' The linesman raises his flag. Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) is adjudged offside.
35' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Sascha Stegemann signals. That's a free kick to Augsburg.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Finn Dahmen.
32' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Manuel Baum isn't happy on the touchline after referee Sascha Stegemann shows him a yellow card.
29' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Marius Wolf (Augsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

29' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from St. Pauli is about to take a penalty kick.
28' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) plants a goal-bound header towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away. The linesman makes the right call and St. Pauli will have a corner.

24' It looks like Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to St. Pauli, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
23' The St. Pauli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
17' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
15' The corner from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is hurriedly cleared.
14' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Finn Dahmen anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
13' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul. Augsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
9' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
6' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

5' James Sands (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner.

4' James Sands (St. Pauli) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
3' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Finn Dahmen comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Sascha Stegemann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
